name: app-template
description: Company standard Databricks App: Vite + React frontend, Flask backend.

scripts.predev: npm run db:up && npm run migrate
scripts.migrate: node scripts/py.mjs alembic -c backend/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.lint: npm run lint:py && npm run lint:web
scripts.lint:py: node scripts/py.mjs ruff check . && node scripts/py.mjs ruff format --check .
scripts.lint:web: npm run lint -w frontend && npm run typecheck -w frontend && npm run format:check -w frontend
scripts.format: node scripts/py.mjs ruff check --fix . && node scripts/py.mjs ruff format . && npm run format -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:py && npm run test:web
scripts.audit: node scripts/py.mjs pip_audit -r requirements.txt && npm audit --audit-level=high
scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && node scripts/build-bundle.mjs
scripts.deploy:sandbox: npm run build && databricks bundle deploy -t sandbox && databricks bundle run app -t sandbox
